flags.old: Through a smile that never moves, he gives Jaeha an order only he can hear.
flags.problem: The close-up shows Mok's teeth bared in a grimace under a furious brow, which reads as a snarl rather than the held camera smile the line describes.
flags.new: Through clenched teeth, right at his ear, Mok gives an order only Jaeha can hear.

flags.old: He turns the chain link in his bandaged fingers. The knight went home. Whoever chained him is still out there.
flags.problem: The bandage covers his palm and wrist, but the fingers turning the link are bare.
flags.new: He turns the chain link in his bandaged hand. The knight went home. Whoever chained him is still out there.

art_vs_script.note: Script keeps Mok's camera smile on with the teeth clenched; the art reads as an angry bared-teeth grimace under a furious brow.
Script has Yerin and Nib hanging back by the stairs; the art puts them by the room's open door (P37 then shows Nib by a staircase).
Script has Baek's hands folded on the cane's handle; the art has his hands clasped behind his back while the cane stands unheld between his feet.
